route_reviews.plain_language_summary: QuoteRivet lets a customer send job and location details to a contractor so a staff member can review the request before arranging a visit or preparing a quote.
route_reviews.customer_outcome: The customer submits the details once and can see that a named staff member is responsible for reviewing the request.

route_reviews.plain_language_summary: QuoteRivet puts estimate requests from calls, messages, email, web forms, and in-person conversations in one place for office staff to check and assign.
route_reviews.customer_outcome: Office staff can collect missing details, decide whether the company handles the work, and tell each requester who will follow up.

route_reviews.plain_language_summary: This page lists the customer, job, visit, and site details an estimator should check before preparing a quote.
route_reviews.customer_outcome: The estimator can see what information is present, what is missing, and whether there is enough information to prepare a quote.

route_reviews.plain_language_summary: This page keeps the work description, visit time, assigned estimator, access notes, and site details with the same estimate request.
route_reviews.customer_outcome: Office staff and the estimator can keep visit details together and send missing information to the person responsible for fixing it.

route_reviews.plain_language_summary: QuoteRivet organizes estimate-request work while accounting, dispatch, invoicing, payments, and completed-job records stay in the contractor's current systems.
route_reviews.customer_outcome: A contractor can add QuoteRivet without moving its accounting, dispatch, invoicing, payment, or completed-job records.
